detailZones.title: Hotel lobby
detailZones.description: Explore the reception desk, guest seating, floor inlay and lobby objects.

detailZones.title: Elevator and housekeeping hall
detailZones.description: Inspect the elevator hall, stair rail and open housekeeping alcove.

detailZones.title: Upper guest room
detailZones.description: Study the bed, desk, wardrobe, room controls and visible guest amenities.

detailZones.title: Central guest bathroom
detailZones.description: Inspect the vanity, shower enclosure, towel fittings and bathroom controls.

detailZones.title: East guest bathrooms
detailZones.description: Follow the second bathroom row, door hardware, drains and vanity details.

anchorAudit.rationale: The final 1600 by 900 hotel lobby and guest-room photograph was inspected at source and output resolution. It retains 103 independently pointable lobby, elevator, housekeeping, guest-room and bathroom objects or parts. Room occupancy, guest identity, service actions, room numbers and hidden building systems were excluded; repeated rooms share no duplicate display term.
